<!--
Whole-trial harmonization code for the "Harmonizing all datasets in a trial"
slide. Pulled into the deck with an include shortcode pointing at this file.
-->
```{.r style="width: 80%; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 1.2em;"}
trialX_source_files <- list(
  demographics = c("dm.csv", "adsl.csv"),
  lab_tests = "lb.csv",
  medications = "cm.csv",
  response = "adrs.csv"
)
trialX_harmonized <- purrr::imap(
  trialX_source_files,
  \x(f, d) harmonize_trial_dataset(dataset = d, dataset_source_files = f)
)
```
